name: feature.image-gen.agents
description: Image Generator guide. Helps a user shape a strong image prompt and explains the in-app generation affordances. Image generation itself rides its existing non-conversational path (the MediaRef Generate/Edit-with-AI widget and the media generate route / image-generate workflow node — an egress + budget + media-asset dispatch that is deliberately NOT a chat tool). Pure-agent pack; no chat tools.
author: OpenWOP App

agents.label: Image Generator
agents.description: Helps a user craft a strong image prompt and points them to the in-app Generate / Edit-with-AI affordance. Image generation runs through the media-generation path (workflow node / MediaRef widget), not a conversational tool — so this guide has no chat tools and never claims to have produced an image itself.
